answer_1.quote: In order to analyze the generality of E-LANG to other NLP problems rather than text classification (Section 3.2.1), we also apply our method to two text-to-text tasks including SuperGLUE's WSC and WMT's English-to-Romanian (EnRo) translation.

answer_2.quote: As given in the table, our method achieves the Super model's accuracy on both WSC and EnRo with 4.2X and 1.4X less FLOPs, respectively.
